requirements.verifier_assertion: test_load_dataset_excel_basic + _missing_cells + _legacy_xls: load_dataset("excel", data_files=<path>) with .xlsx/.xlsm/.xls returns a Dataset.
test_load_dataset_excel_extension_inference_from_directory + _prefers_excel_when_mixed: passing a directory of .xlsx files to load_dataset resolves to the excel builder.

test_dataset_from_excel + test_datasetdict_from_excel + test_iterable_dataset_from_excel_family: Dataset.from_excel, DatasetDict.from_excel, IterableDataset.from_excel exist and mirror the from_csv trio.
test_dataset_to_excel_contract + _empty_dataset_still_writes_header: Dataset.to_excel returns the number of data rows written as a plain int, not a bool, header excluded.

test_dataset_excel_round_trip: round-tripping through from_excel preserves columns/rows/values regardless of batch_size.
test_dataset_to_excel_produces_valid_xlsx_container: written workbook must be a valid OOXML zip container.
test_dataset_to_excel_empty_dataset_still_writes_header: empty Dataset returns 0 and writes exactly one header row.
test_datasetdict_to_excel: one sheet per split, sheet named after its split.
test_datasetdict_to_excel_preserves_split_insertion_order: sheet order = DatasetDict insertion order, no re-sorting.

test_dataset_to_excel_contract + _null_and_datetime_cells: on write-out, types are native cells (int/float/bool/datetime), not stringified.

test_load_dataset_excel_sheet_selection + _default_is_first + _all_sheets_concatenated + _sheet_list_concatenated_in_order: first sheet by default, by name, by 0-based index, sheet_name=None concat all in workbook order, list concat in list order.

test_load_dataset_excel_multiple_files_concatenated + _data_files_dict_splits: data_files list vertically concatenates; {split: file} dict returns a DatasetDict.
